summary: A Parramatta law practice with free initial advice appears to lose enquiries to a free builder address and a 2017 design credit.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address, with a banner that says This website was built on Wix.
findings.cost: A free builder address makes a law practice look temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a clean branded site.

findings.problem: A credit that reads Web Design with a roman numeral date for 2017 appears in the page text.
findings.cost: An old design credit signals a site that has not been refreshed.
findings.fix: Remove the old credit and refresh the design.

findings.problem: The only email shown appears to be a personal address, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Clients prefer a firm email and a quick message option.
findings.fix: A firm email address and WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The page title appears to read Go To Court New, which does not name the practice area or suburb.
findings.cost: A vague title loses searchers looking for a Parramatta lawyer.
findings.fix: A title with the practice name and suburb.
